title: Pull request safeguards report
summary: How Code Health safeguards work on a project's pull requests: how often the review catches an issue, how many findings authors fix rather than ignore or suppress, whether each pull request maintained Code Health, the trend week by week, and the same per developer and per pull request.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.description: The CodeScene project to report on. Find it with list_projects.

inputs.name: days
inputs.description: How many days back from today to include.

inputs.name: stable_band
inputs.description: Code Health change per pull request, in either direction, that still counts as maintained.
